run_solve_dual: run the verification algorithm to solve the dual problem and update dual state
train_solve_dual_train: train dual Lagrange parameters with gradient-based optimization to minimize the dual loss
eval_solve_dual_eval: evaluate the dual problem to compute a verified upper bound on the objective
build_dual_fun: build the dual loss function from environment, Lagrangian form, inner optimizer, and spec type
project_dual: project dual parameters to satisfy inequality constraints encoded by dual parameter types
